tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content:
**Talverin Hotels & Resorts** operates 40 hotels across Europe. Reservations, loyalty-program records, and guest correspondence are handled in Microsoft 365, and the company is subject to data protection regulations in every market where it operates.

**Current Environment:**
- Guest passport numbers and payment card details appear in booking confirmations, front-desk email, and scanned documents stored in SharePoint Online.
- Email is currently kept forever in some mailboxes and deleted immediately in others, depending on individual staff habits.
- After a complaint from a loyalty-program member, the data protection officer could not easily establish which staff members had accessed the guest's records.

tabs.title: Compliance Objectives
tabs.content:
The data protection officer at Talverin Hotels has set the following objectives:
- **Standardize retention**: All Exchange Online mailboxes must automatically keep messages for three years and then delete them, applied organization-wide at the location level rather than item by item.
- **Know the data**: The compliance team needs a current snapshot showing where documents and emails containing passport numbers and payment card data are located across SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Exchange Online.
- **Answer access questions**: When a guest asks who viewed their data, investigators must be able to search a log of user and admin activities — including which items in a mailbox were accessed — going back at least one year.
